spell.effects.haste_spell.description: Grants the Haste effect while equipped.
spell.effects.haste_spell.upgrade.2: Upgrades the effect from Haste I to Haste II.
spell.effects.leap_spell.description: Launches you forward in the direction you're looking.
spell.effects.leap_spell.upgrade.2: Doubles the distance traveled by the leap.
spell.effects.leap_spell.upgrade.3: Doubles the distance traveled by the leap again.
spell.effects.naturalist_spell.descripti: Gain Regeneration while standing in direct sunlight.
spell.effects.naturalist_spell.upgrade.2: Taking damage has a 2.5% chance to release spores that heal you and nearby trusted allies.
spell.effects.lightning_spell.descriptio: Hitting a player has a 10% chance to briefly stun them.
spell.effects.lightning_spell.upgrade.2: Disabling a player's shield with an axe has a 25% chance to strike them with lightning for 2 hearts of damage (30s cooldown).
spell.effects.lavabender_spell.descripti: Increases your attack damage by 1 while standing in lava.
spell.effects.lavabender_spell.upgrade.2: Fire damage you take builds up; at 5 hearts it erupts, damaging nearby non-trusted players.
spell.effects.enchanter_spell.upgrade.2: Enchanting an item at an enchanting table maxes the level of every enchantment it receives.
spell.effects.hermit_spell.description: Mining continuously builds up Haste over time; it fades after a couple of seconds of not mining.
spell.effects.hermit_spell.upgrade.2: Grants a 10% chance to halve incoming damage.
spell.effects.fortune_spell.description: Eating a golden apple grants 2 extra absorption hearts and a slightly longer Regeneration.
spell.effects.fortune_spell.upgrade.2: Every hit has a 1% chance to spin a roulette of ores and fire a projectile scaled to the result.
spell.effects.watcher_spell.description: Crouching near an invisible player reveals their nametag.
spell.effects.watcher_spell.upgrade.2: Gain Echolocation: every 30 seconds, a nearby entity triggers a directional shriek pulse.
spell.effects.metallurgy_spell.descripti: Orbit Shield: for 5 Iron Ingots, reduce damage taken by 25% for 10 seconds (2 min cooldown).
spell.effects.metallurgy_spell.upgrade.2: Dagger Push: slowly stockpile up to 4 throwing daggers (1 per 5 minutes, 2 Iron Ingots each) that deal 2 hearts when thrown.
spell.effects.metallurgy_spell.upgrade.3: Heavy Slam: for 10 Iron Ingots, deal 5 hearts of AoE damage and briefly stun nearby foes (4 min cooldown).
spell.effects.stealth_spell.description: Hide your nametag for 30 seconds, even while standing (3 min cooldown).
spell.effects.stealth_spell.upgrade.2: Smokescreen: blind and deafen everyone within 20 blocks except you for 15 seconds (5 min cooldown).
spell.effects.stealth_spell.upgrade.3: Cloak: turn fully invisible for up to 20 seconds; cancelled if you hit or are hit (4 min cooldown).
spell.effects.chorus_spell.description: Teleport like a chorus fruit within an 8 block radius (60s cooldown).
spell.effects.chorus_spell.upgrade.2: Fire a shulker bullet at your target, making them levitate for 10 seconds (60s cooldown).
spell.effects.chorus_spell.upgrade.3: For your next 5 hits, teleport next to your target on each hit (2 min cooldown).
spell.effects.beast_tamer_spell.descript: Sneak and right-click a Wither, Warden, Skeleton, or Creeper to absorb it, then use its ability once (3 min cooldown, must re-absorb after use).
Summon a small armored wolf army at your feet (4:30 cooldown, shared with Level 3).
Summon 3 armored Piglin Brutes that fight for you for 60 seconds (4:30 cooldown, shared with Level 2).
spell.effects.beast_tamer_spell.no_mob_l: No absorbed mob loaded - sneak and right-click one first.
spell.effects.archer_spell.description: Shooting an arrow or trident cracks the target's armor, dealing 20% more damage to them for 15 seconds (2 min cooldown).
spell.effects.archer_spell.upgrade.2: Grappling hook: launches you to your target, or pulls them to you while sneaking (45s cooldown).
spell.effects.archer_spell.upgrade.3: For 10 seconds, your arrows home in on your target (2:30 cooldown).
